# Lightpath Study - AI Tutor for Students

## About
Lightpath Study is an AI-powered study app that helps students actually learn instead of just getting answers. Unlike ChatGPT which provides instant answers, Lightpath forces active learning through quizzes, flashcards, and guided tutoring.

## Main Features
- AI Tutor: Asks questions to check understanding, guides students to build their own explanations
- Practice Quizzes: Retrieval practice for stronger memory
- Smart Flashcards: Spaced repetition for long-term retention
- Memory Tricks: Mnemonics and elaborative encoding

## Supported Subjects
Math, science, history, languages, and any subject where students can upload their own notes.

## How It Works
1. Upload lecture slides, textbook chapters, or class notes
2. Engage with AI-powered quizzes, tutor conversations, and flashcards
3. Build real understanding through active recall and retrieval practice
